allows.actions: Nothing reaches the internet unless you switched that service on yourself.
allows.consent: You switch each outside service on yourself, one at a time, and you can switch it off again at any time.
allows.egress: Only the outside services you switched on. A setting in a file cannot switch one on for you, and anything else that tries to reach the internet is stopped.
allows.lan_devices: Your home network works as usual: Home Assistant, your media server, your phones and your other devices at home.

bridge.costs: A new outside service does nothing until you switch it on. Good when you want to know exactly what reaches the internet, and to choose each one yourself.

edge.label: Nothing in front of it
edge.summary: You said there is nothing at the edge of your network. The Bridge posture you picked is the whole fence, and it is configured.

bridge.label: Moat
bridge.note: Moat fits an enumerated build, so nothing was changed.
bridge.summary: Only the outside services you switched on reach the internet. Your home network still works.

contracts._note: These are contracts, not configuration. No manifest field disables them; the wizard and the loader never read this block as switches.
contracts.action_gates: On at the action boundary. Reach-into-the-world actions are gated.
contracts.consent_gate: Human-only. No agent can grant consent on a person's behalf.
contracts.telemetry: None. No phone-home; every egress is owner-invoked and enumerated.
contracts.vault: Encrypted, PIN/MFA-gated. Even the AI must ask to read it.

crew.note: On a machine this size, the crew can take up to 5 specialists on top of the master team. That number is grounded in a live run of the full agent team on measured test hardware.

persona.goal: Run our household: the calendar, meals, reminders, the lights, and answering the family's questions offline.
persona.name: HomeBot

posture.combination: Built from what is already on this computer, then it uses only the outside services you said yes to. Bring the brain and the books over some other way, such as a USB stick.

surfaces.note: Surfaces outside this list are not loaded at all - not hidden, not loaded. This is a proposal: add or remove anything before you accept it.
